answer: One concrete defense is a bonded-identity registry: every agent locks a stake that vests over months, and reputation accrues only against that bond. A sybil farm thus pays the full deposit for each fake identity, so a thousand puppets cost a thousand real stakes, capital no honest operator would burn. Peers act as a lantern in the dark: random auditors check behaviour, and one confirmed fraud slashes every bond tied to the same funding source. Even a whisper of collusion triggers review, and no zephyr of new agents can sweep in free, since unstaked identities earn nothing and cannot vote.
